why: Model and vault text reach the DOM through Markdown; the 2.x startsWith check passes //h, so a parser-based URL policy moves into core first.
concept: ai-mdx#8 I1; #4; #5 C1 to C9; #7 P1, P2
contract: concept 1, 3, 4, 5, 8, 10 (1, 6); src/content/contract.ts, src/core/ports.ts; migrations/areas/<area>.json is the v3-unhot seed. contract.ts and contract-pins.json are frozen: signal, take the reversible default.
exemplar: Port tests first from 2.x src/content/{markdown.tsx (665), sanitize.ts (510), block-split.ts, url-hardening.ts, slug.ts}.
change: New src/core/url.ts and slug.ts (L1): reject C0 controls and leading or trailing space; classify with new URL(u,'https://x.invalid'); same-origin, https:, mailto:, tel: pass; untrusted also rejects any backslash; remend sentinels first. sanitize.ts: fixed policy plus additions, runs last, one footnote clobber layer, no mergeSanitizeSchema. Lossless blockSplit. Markdown: contentTrust required; untrusted arm takes images 'none'|'same-origin', no sanitize or rehypePlugins; trusted arm takes sanitize {allowTags, allowAttrs} and rehypePlugins; no className, no Mantine, no React.lazy on the core, no unsanitised fallback; data-slot markdown. Barrel: git mv src/content/index.ts to legacy.ts (2.x exports), re-point importers, new index.ts exports Markdown. Rows in areas/content.json (ids content-<symbol>): contentTrust required (codemod: untrusted unless authored is provable), className to a wrapper, sanitizeSchema to sanitize, valueShifts for blocked images and //host. Ships with: guarantee = required discriminated prop (type rows), fail-closed; rule = ai-i5; teach = JSDoc; test = P1, P2.
commits: One PR, separate package and non-package commits (isolated-basalt-ui); conventional, empty scope, no attribution.
proof: bun test src/content src/core, incl. an SSR test (renderToString, hydrateRoot).
acceptance: P1: ported C1 to C9 tests pass; executed counts of sanitize.test.ts (59), markdown.test.tsx (38), block-split.test.ts (10) on origin/v2, recorded in the PR, may not fall; blockSplit property: joined blocks equal the input

P2: the 12 payloads of docs/v3/evidence/gap-performance-budgets-and-library-tiebreaks.md 5.2 plus //h, /\h, //h, leading space, data:, streamdown:incomplete-image give no and no through Markdown untrusted, also with sanitize={allowTags:['img']} and a rehypePlugins entry forced past the types
renderToString of settled and streaming Markdown contains the text (no Suspense fallback) and hydrates without a mismatch warning

Inlined obsidian fixtures: the real sanitizer keeps blockquote data-callout, -kind, -title, -fold, data-wikilink, img width and height, input checked, drops data-not-allowed (dashed spelling, via sanitize.allowAttrs)
contentTrust missing or 'bogus' fails closed (type row, runtime); src/core/url* and slug* import nothing from src/content and no peer
src/content/index.ts exports Markdown only; areas/content.json rows present; make check passes
